title: Line Reflection
description:
Given points on a plane, determine whether there is a vertical line that the whole set is symmetric about: the reflection of every point is also in the set.

Example 1:
Input: points = [[1,1],[-1,1]]
Output: true
Explanation: The line x = 0

Example 2:
Input: points = [[1,1],[-1,-1]]
Output: false

Constraints:
- 1 ≤ len(points) ≤ 10^4
- -10^8 ≤ points[i][j] ≤ 10^8
idea: If the line exists, the leftmost point reflects into the rightmost one, so the line sits exactly in the middle: c = (minX + maxX) / 2. Reflecting x across it gives 2c − x = minX + maxX − x, so no division is needed. Put all points into a set and check that every point has its reflection.
